reason: Aggregates reverse image search links for nine engines by constructing URLs from a public image URL without making network requests.

summaries.zh: 根据用户提供的公网图片 URL，生成并汇总多个反向图片搜索引擎的搜索链接。
summaries.en: Generates and aggregates reverse image search links for multiple search engines from a user-provided public image URL.

capabilities: Constructs reverse-image-search URLs from a supplied public image URL
Lists and filters supported search engines
Returns clickable search links and summaries
Performs no network requests or external data retrieval
